topic: Parental leave (yuga hyujik): 1 year per parent, 18 months each if both take 3+ months (2025), pay up to ₩2.5M/2M/1.6M, 6+6 both-parent bonus up to ₩4.5M, 20-day paternity leave, fathers 36.5% of leave-takers (67,200 in 2025)
title: In Korea, Both Parents Get 18 Months Off

slides.kicker: ONE BABY. THREE YEARS OF LEAVE.
slides.headline: In Korea, **each parent** can take 18 months off.
slides.note: Paid, and the job is kept.

slides.headline: It's called **yuga hyujik**
slides.body: Yuga hyujik (육아휴직) means parental leave. Any worker with a child aged 8 or under can ask, and the employer has to say yes.

slides.headline: One year, **plus six months**
slides.body: The leave is one year per parent. Since 2025, if both parents take at least three months, each gets 18 months.

slides.headline: Paid by **insurance**, not the boss
slides.body: Employment insurance pays up to ₩2.5M a month for the first three months, then ₩2M, then ₩1.6M.

slides.headline: Both go on leave, **pay goes up**
slides.body: If both parents take leave before the baby turns 18 months, each gets full salary for six months, up to ₩4.5M in the sixth.

slides.headline: Dads also get **20 days** at birth
slides.body: Separate from parental leave, a father gets 20 paid days off around the birth. It was 10 days until 2025.

slides.headline: And dads are **using it**
slides.body: In 2015, about 1 in 18 people on parental leave was a father. In 2025 it was more than 1 in 3.

slides.headline: Fathers on paid parental leave **in 2025**
slides.body: Up 61% in one year. The most ever.

slides.headline: A country with **0.80 births per woman.**
slides.body: Births rose 6.8% in 2025, the biggest jump in 15 years. Longer leave for both parents is part of the bet.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, each parent can take a year of paid parental leave, and 18 months if both of them use it.

It's called yuga hyujik. The first months pay close to a full salary, and more dads are taking it than ever.

How long can a new dad stay home where you live?
reply: One more thing: the pay comes from employment insurance, so the company does not pay salary during the leave, and it must give the same job or same pay back afterwards. Where you live, who pays for parental leave?
fact_check: 2장: 남녀고용평등법 제19조 제1항(만 8세 이하 또는 초2 이하 자녀, 사업주 허용 의무).
3장: 같은 법 제19조 제2항 제1호(부모 각각 3개월 이상 사용 시 6개월 추가), 2024.10.22 개정·2025.2.23 시행.
4장: 고용보험법 시행령 제95조 제1항(1~3개월 상한 250만, 4~6개월 200만, 7개월~ 통상임금 80% 상한 160만).
6장: 남녀고용평등법 제18조의2 제1항 배우자 출산전후휴가 20일 유급(2024.10.22 개정 전 10일).
8장: 2025년 남성 육아휴직급여 수급자 67,200명, 2024년 41,829명 대비 60.7% 증가, 역대 최대.
댓글: 급여는 고용보험 기금(고용보험법 제70조), 복귀 시 같은 업무 또는 같은 수준 임금 직무(남녀고용평등법 제19조 제4항).
